chunks: O you who believe, when the call to prayer is made on the day of congregation, hasten to remember God, putting aside your business. This is better for you if you can understand.

key_terms.ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ: Remembrance of God (specifically referring to the Friday prayer)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on trade and business activities during the Friday call to prayer?
ai.summary: This verse (Ayat al-Salat) establishes the Friday congregational prayer as a communal obligation, instructing believers to abandon commercial activities upon the call to prayer. Shia scholars highlight the transition from individual to collective worship, emphasizing that 'hastening' implies both physical speed and spiritual readiness, while 'leaving trade' signifies a temporary suspension of worldly pursuits to prioritize divine remembrance.
